thread:
maria_ops: FYI forwarder flagged a manifest mismatch at FRA airgate, 12 H100s on AWB TL12345678. They put the shipment on hold pending paperwork.

jason_procure: Ugh okay. ETA on docs from vendor?

maria_ops: Vendor emailed a corrected manifest about 15m ago but forwarder says their system rejected it — 'manifest hash mismatch'.

liam_log logistics: Can we get the corrected AWB + packing list into their portal? Forwarder gave a case id FG-9987. I asked them to reprocess but they want shipper confirmation.

olivia_finance: If this drags, we need an air uplift vs sea delta calc. What's the cost to expedite replacement vs reroute? :thinking_face:

jason_procure: Short answer: air top-up to edge racks ~ $95k for full express on 12 units. Sea alternative adds 4-6 weeks but <$12k freight.

maria_ops: Risk: customers on Dedicated pool in eu-central will see capacity hit if these are delayed. Can we borrow 6 units from the US pool for 2 weeks?

liam_log logistics: We have 4 hot spares in AMS ready to ship, but customs will need the same manifest corrections. Also forwarder flagged missing serial range in the invoice.

jason_procure: Vendor said serials were omitted due to export control review. They can provide them by EOD after legal signs off.

maria_ops: That's too slow. I asked for a scanned export control acknowledgement to unblock the forwarder.

rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-2024-552 for 2 DOA units found during QA on original batch. Not related to manifest hold but noted in the shipment paperwork.

olivia_finance: RMA will affect warranty credits — keep record. Also tagging @jason_procure: if we air-expedite, confirm who absorbs freight uplift, procurement or ops budget?

jason_procure: Procurement can cover emergency uplift for one-time exception, ops should create a chargeback for the Dedicated pool usage after the fact.

liam_log logistics: Quick ask: can someone paste the AWB and the forwarder case id here? I need to feed into the portal for revalidation.

maria_ops: AWB TL12345678, case FG-9987, vendor manifest v2 attached in their email (I uploaded to the bucket: s3://redwood-ops/procure/1745016789/manifest-v2.pdf).

liam_log logistics: Trying portal reupload now. If the system accepts it, forwarder will release within ~45m.

maria_ops: Thanks. If portal rejects again, plan B: vendor reissue with corrected invoice + explicit serial list. Have legal pre-prep the export confirmation to shave time.

olivia_finance: I'll pre-approve the emergency uplift spend cap at $120k. Please ping me before we finalize actual payment.

jason_procure: I'll chase vendor legal and ask for a signed export attestation ASAP. Also confirming: if release happens today we ship to FRA depot and do depot-to-edge handoff via overnight.

liam_log logistics: Portal accepted the manifest v2. Forwarder updated: release scheduled, pickup in 2hrs. I'll post new ETAs once I get the AWB scan. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: Great work, team. Keep the schedule tight — we need at least 6 units in eu-central by EOD+2 to keep SLAs.

rma-bot: Note: RMA-2024-552 linked to AWB TL12345678 in case notes.

jason_procure: Filing post-mortem action: require vendor manifest + serials in single CSV with invoice at T0 for future high-priority air shipments.

olivia_finance: Also add billing code tag REDWOOD-EMERG-2024 for traceable uplift spends.

maria_ops: Closing loop: once forwarder confirms pickup I'll create a short ops runbook for depot handoff and customs contact list.
